title: Mighty Thor #318 Marvel 1982 Newsstand A Kingdom Lost Easter Island Gil Kane
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
The Mighty Thor #318 (April 1982), Marvel Comics - "A Kingdom Lost!" Loki brings the Easter Island heads to life. Written by Doug Moench, cover and art by Gil Kane. Newsstand edition, 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Gabriel Lone Ranger Western Town ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
